caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, upright piano or harpsichord with a polished, reddish-brown wooden body, four turned wooden legs with gold-colored feet, and a raised back panel. The front panel above the keys includes two small, green lattice-patterned speaker grilles and a central decorative gold motif with intricate detailing. The keyboard consists of alternating white and black keys, set almost centrally on the piano’s front. The overall composition centers the instrument against a plain, light beige background, with the instrument occupying the majority of the visual space. The artist's signature and a series identification are visible along the lower edge of the drawing.
title: Piano Forte
